chunks.title: CR 01 | Change with Block Booking Type
chunks.heading: Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › CR 01 | Change with Block Booking Type
chunks.text:
At present, system has two type of Block Booking as “Projection” and “Reservations”.
Type= ”Projection” – No change in existing behavior
The behavior of system will remain same as of today in case of “projection”.
Type= ”Reservation” – change in existing behavior
In case of “Reservation”, below three changes will be incorporated in existing functionality.
• Mandatory Style Selection
• Add “Color” tab on Block Booking Line
• Link Projection
• Import and Export Option
chunks.locator: § Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › CR 01 | Change with Block Booking Type

chunks.title: Change 01 | Style Mandatory in case of Reservation Type
chunks.heading: Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 01 | Style Mandatory in case of Reservation Type
chunks.text: In case user selects “Buyer Block Booking Type” as “Reservation” then Style selection on Block Booking Line will be mandatory.
chunks.locator: § Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 01 | Style Mandatory in case of Reservation Type

chunks.title: Change 02 | Style Color Column in case of Reservation Type
chunks.heading: Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 02 | Style Color Column in case of Reservation Type
chunks.text: In case user selects “Buyer Block Booking Type” as “Reservation” then there will be one new column associated with Style as “Article Color” which will list all colors of selected style. By default., “All” will be listed here. However, selection of color will not be mandatory.
chunks.locator: § Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 02 | Style Color Column in case of Reservation Type

chunks.title: Change 03 | Linking Projections in case of Reservation Type
chunks.heading: Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 03 | Linking Projections in case of Reservation Type
chunks.text: In case user selects “Buyer Block Booking Type” as “Reservation” then there will be an option “Link Projection” where system will provide option to link existing buyer projections to “Reservation” type block booking.
chunks.locator: § Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 03 | Linking Projections in case of Reservation Type

chunks.title: Validations:
chunks.heading: Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 03 | Linking Projections in case of Reservation Type › Validations:
chunks.text:
This linking option will be visible only in case of “Reservation” Type.
This will show block booking only of type as “Projections”
User will be able to link only one block booking line to a “Reservation” Type block booking.
Linking of Blocking will work with the same logic as it is working on Sales Order.
chunks.locator: § Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 03 | Linking Projections in case of Reservation Type › Validations:

chunks.title: Change 04 | Linking Projections to Sales Order
chunks.heading: Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 04 | Linking Projections to Sales Order
chunks.text:
Selection of Buyer Block booking in sales order
In case a “Reservation” type block booking exists for a customer, department and season and has leftover quantities (balance to link) then system will make selection of block booking mandatory on sales order.
There should be an option to link Reservations against Style color in Sales Order.
chunks.locator: § Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 04 | Linking Projections to Sales Order

chunks.heading: Section 3. Functional Requirement Description › Change 05 | Linking Projections to Sales Order
chunks.text:

Catalog: Already developed and working against helpdesk ID: 352391
